highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.148.0 is the first stable v4 release, built on Skia m148.
highlights_body: It rolls up the 4.147.x previews: variable font and color-font support, animated WebP encoding, a Vulkan/native-struct cleanup, and updated native dependencies. This is a breaking release from v3 - review the changes below before upgrading.

breaking.title: Default typeface resolution changed (empty vs. default vs. null)
breaking.body: new SKFont() now stores an empty typeface (MeasureText returns 0) instead of lazily resolving a platform default; new SKPaint().Typeface now returns SKTypeface.Default instead of null; and SKTypeface.FromFamilyName("missing") now returns Default (never null) on every platform, including Android. Replace null checks with Typeface.IsEmpty, construct SKFont with an explicit typeface, or use SKFontManager.Default.MatchFamily for a strict null-on-miss check.

breaking.title: SKStream.Move(long) now throws on overflow and is obsolete
breaking.body: The previously-silent (int) truncation of large offsets is now a checked cast that throws OverflowException, and the overload is [Obsolete]. Call Move(int) with an in-range, pre-validated offset instead.

breaking.title: GRContext.CreateVulkan aborts the process on Vulkan 1.0
breaking.body: Ganesh now requires Vulkan 1.1; instead of returning null on a 1.0 instance/device it calls SK_ABORT and terminates the process, which cannot be caught. Declare VK_API_VERSION_1_1 on both the VkApplicationInfo used to create the instance and on GRVkBackendContext.MaxAPIVersion (do not leave either at its default 0/1.0).

breaking.title: Vulkan interop structs changed shape
breaking.body: GRVkBackendContextNative drops fMinAPIVersion, fInstanceVersion, fExtensions, fFeatures, and fOwnsInstanceAndDevice - use fVkExtensions and fDeviceFeatures/fDeviceFeatures2 instead, and manage instance/device lifetime yourself. GrVkYcbcrConversionInfo gains a Components field and loses value-equality (Equals/==/!=); GRVkImageInfo.YcbcrConversionInfo is retyped to the new GRVkYcbcrConversionInfo. Also, SKNativeObject.IgnorePublicDispose loses its public setter.

breaking.title: Remaining pre-v4 obsolete APIs promoted to compile errors
breaking.body: Legacy SKPaint text/font state-reading members and other pre-v4 obsolete APIs (and obsolete enum members trimmed from the ref assembly) now fail to build instead of warning. Migrate call sites onto SKFont per the v3 deprecation guidance before upgrading.

bullets.detail: Rolls the bundled engine forward across the 4.147.x preview line to Chrome milestone m148, plus multiple rounds of merged upstream bug fixes.
Adds variable font support across SkiaSharp and HarfBuzzSharp, color font palette support, and an HBColor struct for hb_color_t, plus assorted missing API wrappers and naming fixes.

bullets.lead: Animated WebP encoding and zero-copy streams
bullets.detail: Adds SKWebpEncoder support for animated WebP output and SKStream.GetData() for zero-copy stream-to-data conversion.
SKSurface.Draw and SKCanvas.DrawSurface now accept SKSamplingOptions.
SKPixmap/SKBitmap.GetPixelSpan now use RowBytes for stride, and the generic GetPixelSpan<T>(x,y) offset uses Height instead of Width.
Fixes a crash when an SKPathBuilder is garbage-collected before the SKPath it built.
Fixes the WinUI Projection DLL not being found for .NET 9 consumers, and SKGLView not rendering after a tab switch in a MAUI TabBar.
Reworks how singleton instances are created and torn down, and moves the native-compatibility gate from a module initializer to the SkiaApi static constructor for more predictable startup.
Adds Linux Bionic native asset support and Tizen x64/arm64 native builds, and fixes Apple platform TFMs to use 26.0 for libraries and unversioned TFMs for apps.
Uses PolySharp to bring C# 13 language features to legacy target frameworks.
Updates expat, harfbuzz, libjpeg-turbo, freetype, zlib, libpng, and libexpat to their latest patched versions.

contributor_summaries.ramezgerges: Singleton lifecycle rework, promoting SKPaint text/font members to compile errors, the SKPath finalizer fix, variable font support, moving default-typeface resolution to the managed layer, the Skottie/Uno sample fix, bumping Skia to m147, and updating SkiaSharpGenerator to work on Linux
contributor_summaries.4Darmygeometry: Linux Bionic native asset support and PolySharp-based C# 13 support for legacy TFMs
contributor_summaries.ebariche: Contributed a fix included in this release
contributor_summaries.sasakrsmanovic: Contributed a fix included in this release
contributor_summaries.SimonvBez: Fixed SKGLView not rendering after a tab switch in a MAUI TabBar

preview_summaries.v4.147.0-preview.1.1: Preview 1 opened the v4 line on Skia milestone 132/133, with the initial default-typeface managed-layer rework and native asset target additions.
preview_summaries.v4.147.0-preview.2.1: Preview 2 added variable font and color-font support, the HBColor struct, and Vulkan/native-struct interop cleanup.
preview_summaries.v4.147.0-preview.3.1: Preview 3 added animated WebP encoding, SKStream.GetData(), the singleton lifecycle rework, and updated native dependencies.
preview_summaries.v4.148.0-rc.1.2: The release candidate promoted the remaining pre-v4 obsolete APIs to compile errors, fixed the pixel-access stride/offset bugs, and updated to Skia milestone 148 ahead of stable.

harfbuzz_summary: Adds the HBColor struct for hb_color_t, brings variable font support to HarfBuzzSharp, and updates the bundled HarfBuzz to 14.2.0.
